entities.summary: Hon. Francis Manu-Adabor is a Ghanaian politician and member of the Seventh Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana and the 8th Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana. He was representing the Ahafo Ano South East in the Ashanti Region on the ticket of the New Patriotic Party.
